articles.title: Pakistan hikes petroleum levy on petrol, diesel; keeps retail prices unchanged
articles.titleEn: Pakistan hikes petroleum levy on petrol, diesel; keeps retail prices unchanged
articles.summary: Pakistan's government has increased the petroleum levy on petrol and diesel, keeping retail prices steady despite falling international oil rates. Consumers will continue paying the same for petrol and diesel, while kerosene prices have been reduced. This move boosts government revenue as global oil prices hit pre-war lows following a US-Iran accord and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
